added_claim_errors: '근로복지공단 소액체당금' is the old name of 간이대지급금, and the condition '회사가 사실상 도산했다면' is wrong: 간이대지급금 can be claimed while the business is still operating.
'어느 기준으로 봐도 요건에 해당할 가능성이 높고' never states the 60-day total-delay-days criterion; hedged by '아예 못 받으셨다면', so low severity.
Lists 구직촉진수당 (월 50만원, 최대 6개월) in the same ordered list as 구직급여 without saying it can be excluded while receiving 구직급여; the cue '자격을 확인하세요' softens it.
'고용24에서 수급자격 신청' omits 구직신청, the online education and the 고용센터 visit, so the procedure is incomplete.
The 1350 link is cited as the basis; it is a checkable link, but I did not open it and cannot say how far it supports the text.

'7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고' is an overclaim: the test is total delayed or unpaid days (60 or more), not the number of months, so a few days late each month may fall short. Partly offset by asking at the end whether any pay was received.
'2년 근무면 150일분이 나오고' leaves out that age 50 or over, or a disability, gives 180 days.
'이 기간은 회사 사정으로 늘어나지 않아요' is an odd, unsupported phrasing; the claim is unverifiable as written.
'진정 결과는 실업급여 심사에도 도움이 됩니다' has no source and depends on the case.
조기재취업수당 is given as '남은 급여의 절반, 12개월 이상 근무 시' without the condition of at least half the 소정급여일수 remaining.
The imaeil article and 1350 links are cited as the basis; they are checkable links, but I did not open them and cannot say how far they support the text.

reasons: Both answers correct the premise in the first sentence, cite 시행규칙 별표 2 ('이직 전 1년 이내 2개월 이상 임금체불') and tell her to apply now. B also gives the 12 months from the day after leaving, 150 days of benefit, 66,048 to 68,100 won a day, about 1.98 to 2.04 million won a month (30-day basis) and about 10 million won in total, all of which recompute correctly. It adds 비과세, 간이대지급금 up to 10 million won, 연 20% 지연이자 and 조기재취업수당, and says that looking for work early costs her nothing. A has no amounts, no 소정급여일수 and no 조기재취업수당. It also gives wrong or outdated advice on 소액체당금 and '도산'. Neither explains the 60-day day-count test, and B's '석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고' is less careful than A's conditional '아예 못 받으셨다면', but B asks whether she received part of the pay. B is longer than the requested 짧게, but it gives far more usable information, so B wins clearly.
